item.title: How to Watch UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway 2 Live Online for Free
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest episode of our podcast! Today, we're talking about the highly anticipated UFC 329 event, where Conor McGregor makes his return to the octagon after a five-year hiatus. Let's dive in!"
[Music transitions to a brief sound effect]
Host: "UFC 329 is set to take place on July 11th at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, with the main card starting at 9 pm ET/6 pm PT. The main event, featuring Conor McGregor vs. Max Holloway, is expected to start around 11:59 pm ET/8:59 pm PT."
[Music transitions to a short clip of a crowd cheering]
Host: "This welterweight rematch is a big deal, folks! McGregor, now 37 years old, is looking to prove he can still compete at a world-class level after a five-year break. His last match was a TKO loss to Dustin Poirier in 2021, so he's hungry for a win. Meanwhile, Max Holloway is seeking revenge after losing to McGregor in 2013."
[Music transitions back to the main theme]
Host: "Now, if you're wondering how to watch UFC 329 live online, we've got you covered. The event is streaming on Paramount+, and you can get access to it through a few different options. DirecTV is offering a five-day free trial, which includes Paramount+ with its 'Premier' package. Alternatively, you can sign up for Walmart+ and get Paramount+ for just $1."
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Make sure to tune in to UFC 329 on July 11th to see Conor McGregor's big return to the octagon. Thanks for listening, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
